component.name: ks-button
component.description: The action control. Announces an action, never a destination.

selectionCriteria.primary: The single main action in a view. One per view — never two.
selectionCriteria.secondary: Supporting actions shown alongside a primary.
selectionCriteria.ghost: Tertiary actions in dense UI where visual weight would compete with content.
selectionCriteria.danger: Destructive actions that have already been confirmed elsewhere.

commonPatterns.name: submit-with-loading
commonPatterns.description: Form submit that must not reflow while pending.

antiPatterns.scenario: Using ks-button to navigate to another page
antiPatterns.reason: Buttons announce actions; links announce destinations. Screen-reader users navigate by role, so a button that navigates is unreachable in a links list.

antiPatterns.scenario: Two primary buttons in one view
antiPatterns.reason: Primary means the single main action. Two primaries means neither is.
Produces an unlabelled control in the accessibility tree. The component warns in dev but cannot fix it.

antiPatterns.scenario: Removing the element from the tab order while disabled
antiPatterns.reason: A keyboard user auditing a form cannot find a control they cannot focus.
antiPatterns.alternative: aria-disabled plus suppressed activation — which is what this component does

parentConstraints: Must not be nested inside another interactive element

states.name: focus-visible
states.a11y: 2px ring at 2px offset, ≥3:1 against both the control and the surface behind it

states.name: disabled
states.a11y: aria-disabled=true, remains focusable, carries an inset border as a non-colour signal

states.name: loading
states.a11y: aria-busy=true, label persists, width does not change

interactions.click: fires click unless disabled or loading

accessibility.accessibleName: From slotted text, or aria-label when icon-only
accessibility.screenReader: Announces name, role, and disabled/busy state
accessibility.focusManagement: delegatesFocus on the shadow root; never traps
accessibility.nonColorSignal: Disabled carries an inset border and not-allowed cursor; loading carries a spinner
accessibility.targetSize: 44×44 via an invisible ::after hit area, so the visual control is not inflated

aiHints.context: Reach here for any action. For navigation, reach for a link instead.
